title: Eligible Purchases and Merchants under Pocketwire Pay in 4
content:
A purchase is split into a Pocketwire Pay in 4 plan only when the account and the purchase meet the following conditions.

**Condition 1 — account status.** A plan can be created only while the account status is active. The status is the one the Pocketwire Pay in 4 account shows in the company's records before the plan is created; an account that is applied, past due, suspended or closed cannot create a plan.

**Condition 2 — purchase amount.** The purchase must be between the tier's smallest and largest purchase that can be split, both figures included.

**Condition 3 — merchant category.** The purchase must not fall in an excluded merchant category. Purchases in the categories gambling, cryptocurrency, gift cards and money transfer can never be split, on any tier.

**Condition 4 — merchant location.** The purchase must be from a United States merchant, unless the tier allows international merchants.

A purchase that fails any of conditions 2 to 4 cannot be split.

### Purchase terms by tier

| Tier | Smallest purchase (USD) | Largest single purchase (USD) | Merchants outside the United States | Excluded merchant categories |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter | 30.00 | 250.00 | Not allowed | gambling, cryptocurrency, gift cards, money transfer |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic | 30.00 | 500.00 | Not allowed | gambling, cryptocurrency, gift cards, money transfer |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Select | 30.00 | 1000.00 | Not allowed | gambling, cryptocurrency, gift cards, money transfer |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Preferred | 30.00 | 1500.00 | Allowed | gambling, cryptocurrency, gift cards, money transfer |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Premier | 30.00 | 1500.00 | Allowed | gambling, cryptocurrency, gift cards, money transfer |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Elite | 30.00 | 2000.00 | Allowed | gambling, cryptocurrency, gift cards, money transfer |

The terms that apply are those of the tier the account is on when the purchase is made.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical purchases)

| Account tier | Purchase | Result under conditions 2 to 4 |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter | USD 30.00 at a United States grocery merchant | Can be split — the smallest purchase is included |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter | USD 29.99 at the same merchant | Cannot be split — below the smallest purchase |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic | USD 500.00 at a United States electronics merchant | Can be split — the largest purchase is included |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic | USD 500.01 at the same merchant | Cannot be split — above the largest purchase |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Select | USD 200.00 at a merchant outside the United States | Cannot be split — international merchants not allowed |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Preferred | USD 200.00 at a merchant outside the United States | Can be split as far as location is concerned |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Elite | USD 100.00 for gift cards | Cannot be split — excluded category on every tier |

### What a new plan records

A plan created from a purchase shows its plan reference as it appears in the app, the merchant, the purchase date and the purchase amount; the purchase amount is added to what the customer owes on Pocketwire Pay in 4.
